count.zh-CN: 徽章内容，数字或字符串按文字显示；传入 JSX 元素时直接渲染该元素，并去掉 type 与 theme 对应的样式类。
count.en-US: Badge content: a number or string is shown as text; a JSX element is rendered as is, and the type and theme classes are removed.

countClassName.en-US: Class name of the count element.

countStyle.zh-CN: 内容区域的样式，可传 CSS 对象（键为 kebab-case）或字符串。
countStyle.en-US: Style of the count element, as a CSS object with kebab-case keys or a string.

dot.zh-CN: 显示为小圆点，不展示内容。
dot.en-US: Shows a small dot instead of the content.

overflowCount.zh-CN: 数字内容的最大展示值，超出后显示为 `${overflowCount}+`；只对数字生效，0 视为未设置。
overflowCount.en-US: Maximum number shown; larger numbers display as `${overflowCount}+`. Applies to numbers only, and 0 counts as unset.

position.zh-CN: 徽章相对被包裹元素的位置；缺省时 RTL 的 ConfigProvider 下为 leftTop，否则为 rightTop。
position.en-US: Badge position relative to the wrapped element. Defaults to leftTop under an RTL ConfigProvider and rightTop otherwise.

theme.en-US: Badge theme: solid, light or inverted.

type.en-US: Badge type: primary, secondary, tertiary, danger, warning or success.
